name: behavioral-tuning
description: Diagnoses and fixes Claude behavioral issues in system prompts and Projects using tested countermeasure templates. Use when "Claude is too verbose," "keeps hedging," "agrees with everything," "claims it did something it didn't," "won't use a tool," "Claude stops halfway," "keeps double-checking," "spawns subagents for everything," "adds tests I didn't ask for," "fix Claude's output," "tune Claude's behavior," "Claude ignores my preferences," "adds unsolicited disclaimers," "uses too many lists." Covers fifteen tendencies — agreeableness, verbosity, tool miscalibration, editorial drift, self-referential fabrication — plus over-verification, scope expansion, subagent over-delegation, correction narration, early turn termination. Also use when auditing a system prompt for behavioral calibration or recalibrating a pre-5.5 prompt, and when users describe recurring output problems without naming a tendency. Do NOT use for scoring a prompt's overall quality — use prompt-validation if available.
